description: Header file defining helper classes, functions, and data structures for renderer utilities in ANGLE project, including resource serials, pixel formats, texture handling, and matrix uniforms.

classes.name: ResourceSerial
classes.description: Manages serial numbers for resources, with states for dirty and empty.

classes.name: Serial
classes.description: Represents a serial number with comparison operators and serialization support.

classes.name: SerialFactoryBase
classes.description: Template class for generating serial numbers.

classes.name: FastCopyFunctionMap
classes.description: Maps pixel formats to copy functions for fast pixel data operations.

classes.name: LoadImageFunctionInfo
classes.description: Holds a load image function and a flag indicating if conversion is needed.

classes.name: IncompleteTextureSet
classes.description: Handles incomplete textures used as placeholders.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixGLSL
classes.description: Helper for setting GLSL-style matrix uniforms.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixHLSL
classes.description: Helper for setting HLSL-style matrix uniforms.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a format ID exists in the fast copy map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the copy function for a given format ID.

methods.name: PackPixels
methods.description: Packs pixel data according to specified parameters.

methods.name: initializeMultisampleTextureToBlack
methods.description: Initializes a multisample texture to black (virtual method).

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the incomplete texture set is destroyed.

methods.name: getIncompleteTexture
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an incomplete texture.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Sets uniform matrix data for GLSL or HLSL.

methods.name: GetMatrixUniform
methods.description: De-transposes a matrix uniform for API queries.

methods.name: GetFormatFromFormatType
methods.description: Returns a format object based on GLenum format and type.

methods.name: ComputeStartVertex
methods.description: Calculates the starting vertex for drawing.

methods.name: GetVertexRangeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves vertex range info for drawing commands.

methods.name: ClipRectToScissor
methods.description: Clips a rectangle to the current scissor rectangle.

methods.name: OverrideFeaturesWithDisplayState
methods.description: Overrides feature set based on display state.

methods.name: LineLoopRestartIndexCountHelper
methods.description: Calculates the number of indices in a line loop with restart.

methods.name: GetLineLoopWithRestartIndexCount
methods.description: Gets index count for line loop with restart.

methods.name: CopyLineLoopIndicesWithRestart
methods.description: Copies line loop indices with restart handling.
